result.instructions: Tools for AccuRanker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our tracked keywords moved up into the top 3 this week?"; "Show the share of voice and average rank of our domain for the last 30 days."; "List the keywords that rank between 11 and 20 with commercial intent.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AccuRanker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run accuranker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run accuranker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run accuranker_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. accuranker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: accuranker_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the AccuRanker accounts the token can read (id and name). Use it first to confirm the connection. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/accounts/.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Index of the first result (for paging).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields, dot notation for nested data (default: id,name).

tools.name: accuranker_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List tracked domains with their daily history (average rank, share of voice, traffic value, search volume) for a date range. Good first call to find a domain id. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Index of the first result (for paging).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields, dot notation for nested data (default: id,domain,display_name,history.date,history.average_rank,history.share_of_voice,history.traffic_value,history.search_volume).

period_from.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Set with period_to.

period_to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Set with period_from.

tools.name: accuranker_search_keywords
tools.title: Search keywords with filters
tools.description: Find keywords of one domain that match filters, for example rank below 10 or a keyword that contains a word. Send a flat list of filters joined by one operator. Filter names come from accuranker_list_filters. Read only: the request body only selects data. AccuRanker Read API: POST /api/v4/domains/{domain_pk}/keywords/.

name.description: Filter name from accuranker_list_filters, e.g. rank or keyword.

comparator.description: Comparison, e.g. lt, gt, contains, between.

value.description: Value to compare; use a two-item array for between.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields, dot notation for nested data (default: id,keyword,tags,ranks.rank,ranks.created_at,ranks.estimated_visits,ranks.share_of_voice).

period_from.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Set with period_to.

period_to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Set with period_from.

tools.name: accuranker_list_segments
tools.title: List saved segments
tools.description: List the saved segments (saved filter sets) this token can apply, with their filters. Pass a segment id as segment_id to other tools. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/segments/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_filters

tools.description: List every filter name usable in accuranker_search_keywords, with its value type, allowed comparators and allowed values. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/filters/.
